meta.name: add-deltachat
meta.description: Add DeltaChat channel integration via @deltachat/stdio-rpc-server. Native adapter — no Chat SDK bridge. Email-based messaging with end-to-end encryption.

copy.tagline: 通过 DeltaChat 集成加密邮件通信
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在应用中添加端到端加密的邮件聊天功能
copy.tagline_en: Integrate encrypted email messaging via DeltaChat
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to add end-to-end encrypted email chat to your app

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 能够通过 DeltaChat（基于电子邮件的加密通信系统）收发消息，支持一对一私聊和群聊，还能发送和接收文件附件、设置机器人头像。
howto.when: 用户在 DeltaChat 中通过邀请链接或二维码添加机器人为联系人后发送消息，或群聊中有人发送消息时，Claude 会自动响应。

say.text: 你好，帮我查一下今天的天气。
say.note: 机器人会回复天气信息。
需管理员权限，可更改机器人头像。

say.text: 在群聊中@机器人 问个问题。
say.note: 机器人会按名称被提及后回应。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can send and receive encrypted messages via DeltaChat (email-based messaging), supporting one-on-one DMs and group chats, as well as file attachments and avatar changes.
howto.when_en: When a user adds the bot as a contact via invite link or QR code in DeltaChat and sends a message, or when anyone sends a message in a group containing the bot, Claude will respond.

say_en.text: Hello, can you check the weather today?
say_en.note: The bot will reply with weather info.

say_en.text: In group chat, @bot to ask a question.
say_en.note: Bot responds when addressed by name.
